#
# Field Descriptions:
#   store_pc        : Program Counter (hexadecimal) of the store instruction that spilled data to memory
#   load_pc         : Program Counter (hexadecimal) of the load instruction that retrieved the spilled data
#   memory_address  : Memory address (hexadecimal) where the spill occurred
#   store_tick      : Simulation time (decimal) when the store operation happened
#   load_tick       : Simulation time (decimal) when the load operation happened
#   tick_diff       : Time difference (decimal) between store and load operations
#   store_inst_count: Global instruction counter when store occurred
#   load_inst_count : Global instruction counter when load occurred
#
# Each line represents one detected register spill event
